title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, first to vetted cyber defenders
summary: Google released its Gemini 4 Argon flagship first to trusted cyber defenders, saying it can autonomously find, validate and fix critical vulnerabilities, before paid API access.
reason: New frontier model with notable gains; staged release due to cyber capability.

title: OpenAI accuses Moonshot-linked users of coordinated distillation campaign
summary: OpenAI said a coordinated distillation campaign of 16,000 requests from 4,000+ users, with a core cluster linked to China's Moonshot AI, tried to extract hidden reasoning from its models.
reason: Escalating US-China lab friction over model extraction.

title: Anthropic: open-weight GLM-5.3 nearly matches Claude at autonomous exploit-building
summary: Anthropic's red team said Zhipu's open-weight GLM-5.3 built end-to-end exploits in 50 of 410 attempts vs 56 for Claude Mythos Preview, and its refusals were easily bypassed.
reason: Advanced offensive cyber capability now freely available in open weights; rival-lab assessment.
